run_mako_plugin: run the mako_plugin function to generate test targets from fuzzer build targets in a dictionary
create_fuzzer_test_targets: create test build targets from fuzzer targets by appending one corpus entry fuzzer source files
generate_corpus_tests: generate individual test entries for each corpus file found in a fuzzer target's corpus directories
review_mako_plugin: review the mako_plugin function that transforms fuzzer targets into test targets with corpus-based test entries
refactor_mako_plugin: refactor the mako_plugin to customize test entry properties like excluded configs or supported platforms
